title: Correct final answers
description: Essential Criteria: Student must provide the three numerical answers: 0.8 Wb, 5.6 Wb, and 13.6 Wb.

title: Part 1 area calculation
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly calculate the triangular area from the rod's displacement (x = vt = 4 m) using S = ½ x².

title: Part 2 flux change
description: Important Criteria: Student must compute the initial flux (Φ = B₀S) and final flux (Φ₁ = B'S) before finding ΔΦ₂ = Φ₁ - Φ.

title: Part 3 combined change
description: Important Criteria: Student must compute the final flux with both new B and new S (Φ₂ = BₜSₜ) and subtract the initial flux.

title: Magnetic flux formula
description: Essential Criteria: Student must apply the formula Φ = B⋅S (or ΔΦ = Δ(B⋅S)) for each part, recognizing perpendicular field.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Student should maintain correct units (T, m², Wb) throughout and express final answers in webers.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if student incorrectly treats flux change as negative or confuses initial/final values in subtraction.

title: Area misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if student uses wrong geometry (e.g., rectangle instead of triangle) in part 1 or misapplies given areas in parts 2/3.
